assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Impact-map.md Field Inheritance section: 'Priority: High — propagated to all created tasks and epics via additional_fields.priority' with JSON showing {"priority": {"name": "High"}}. Summary-comment.md Inherited Fields section: 'Priority: High — propagated to all created tasks and epics. The Feature's priority is "High" (not "Undefined"), so it was included in additional_fields.priority on every created issue.'

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Impact-map.md Field Inheritance section: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — propagated to all created tasks and epics via additional_fields.fixVersions (fixVersion scope defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md)' with JSON showing {"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]}. Summary-comment.md: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — propagated to all created tasks and epics. The Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array, and no fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults (defaults to "both"), so fixVersions were included in additional_fields.fixVersions on every created issue.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists and contains an 'Inherited Fields' section documenting: 'Priority: High — propagated to all created tasks and epics' and 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — propagated to all created tasks and epics' with JSON showing exact values. Additionally, impact-map.md contains a 'Field Inheritance' section with the same information. Both files explain why the fields were propagated (priority is not Undefined, fixVersions is non-empty, scope defaults to both).
